# Manual Forensic Extraction: Nanbeige Tokenizer

Control tokens must maintain special: true and normalized: false.

rules.title: Tokenizer Special Token Normalization Boundary
rules.content: Control tokens in added_tokens_decoder must specify special: true and normalized: false to avoid stripping preceding whitespace.
rules.summary: Fast tokenizer control tokens require normalized: false to preserve whitespace boundaries.
rules.actionable_instruction: Assert control tokens in added_tokens_decoder have normalized: false.

fixCommits: Fix whitespace stripping defect on special tokens
closedIssues: Issue #44: tokenizer strips space before control token
